description: This file declares interfaces for high-resolution timing functions in an embedded system firmware, providing timestamps in microseconds, milliseconds, and seconds, along with necessary includes and macro definitions.

methods.name: getTimeNowUs
methods.description: Returns a 64-bit timestamp in microseconds since MCU reset.

methods.name: getTimeNowNt
methods.description: Returns a 64-bit counter of CPU cycles since MCU reset.

methods.name: getHalTimer
methods.description: Returns the hardware abstraction layer's timer value.

methods.name: currentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since system initialization.

methods.name: getTimeNowSeconds
methods.description: Returns current system time in seconds.
